usage_note: This is a French basketball player. In Latvian his name is respelled by its French pronunciation: Sylvain becomes Silvēns and Francisco becomes Fransisko. The first name declines as a 1st-declension masculine noun (Silvēna, Silvēnam). The surname ends in -o, so it stays undeclined in every case. As a result, the surname-only form 'Fransisko' used in running sports copy never changes. Do not keep the original spelling 'Sylvain Francisco' in Latvian text. | Tēzaurs morpho-api applied (agreed)
